words.example: Mum is busy in the kitchen.
I go to school by bus.

lessons.title: What a day!
lessons.en:
Ben: Hi, Anna! How was your day?
Anna: Great! We played games at school.
Ben: That sounds fun.
Anna: Yes, but I am very tired now.
Ben: Go home and have a rest!
lessons.cn:
本：嗨，安娜！今天过得怎么样？
安娜：好极了！我们在学校玩了游戏。
本：听起来很有趣。
安娜：是的，不过我现在好累。
本：那就回家休息一下吧！

lessons.title: A busy day
lessons.en: Today is a busy day. In the morning I went to school. I had four lessons. We sang songs and played games. After school I helped Mum at home. At night I read a book in bed. I am tired, but I am very happy. What a great day!
lessons.cn: 今天是忙碌的一天。早上我上学了。我上了四节课。我们唱歌、玩游戏。放学后我在家帮妈妈。晚上我在床上看了一本书。我很累，但是很开心。多么棒的一天啊！
